zh.title: 固定坐标下的pick & place
zh.summary: 做了个小小的demo，通过语音完成简单的pick & place任务，这个时候物体坐标都是固定写死的，作为上手的第一个项目，主要是为了熟悉整个系统的运行流程。

en.title: Fixed-Coordinate Pick-and-Place
en.summary: I built a small voice-controlled demo that performs a basic pick-and-place task using fixed, hard-coded object coordinates. As my first hands-on robotics project, it helped me understand the complete system workflow and how voice commands are translated into robot actions.
